name: Outlaw Tools v0.13.0
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.13.0

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.13.0

## Outlaw Link for Windows

- Enable the optional Link host in Settings to read refinery orders and saved Shopping targets from the native Android companion. Hosting starts off each time you launch the desktop app.
- Pair each device with a one-time code and explicitly approve its access. Review or revoke remembered devices, export the desktop's public trust file, and reset trust when needed.
- Link access follows the selected player profile. Switching profiles, replacing data or shutting down closes existing sessions. Player records remain on your PCs.
- Android downloads are distributed separately. This release does not add game controls, voice commands or editable mobile dashboards.

## Controls Review

- Review selected controls XML files in Settings. Search and page keyboard evidence without applying bindings or sending game input. Default and override files must be supplied separately.

## Reference Data

- Compatible reference data can update independently of app versions. Updates download in the background and activate on the next launch; Settings includes Check data updates. Saved player data is retained.
- Providers update independently. Each source keeps its actual build label, and unavailable or invalid updates retain the last valid data.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums. Desktop Link hosting is available on Windows; the Android companion has its own release.
